atmosphere._note: Map haze and colour grade (map/map_scene.gd): depth fog from haze_begin to haze_end metres reaching haze_max, aerial perspective blending far land toward the sky, and a saturation, contrast and brightness grade. Tuned against docs/reference/tw/terrain_1.png (not committed).

_note: Campaign-map presentation (not gameplay). Lord and hero figures are deliberately oversized (constitution, Art direction: campaign map scale); lord_scale multiplies the prototype commander figure (about 4.4 m to the helmet top at scale 1). min_figure_px keeps a figure at least this tall on screen when zoomed out. Army banners (ui/army_banner.gd) float banner_lift metres above the figure's top, at banner_scale_near (camera closest) to banner_scale_far (farthest 3D zoom), never below banner_min_scale, and fade out between banner_fade_start and banner_fade_end metres of camera distance when zoomed very close. Owner, 2026-10-04: lords about 2x, tuned against the TW:WH3 reference (docs/reference/tw/).

camera._note: Campaign camera (core/camera_rig.gd; TW:WH3 plus its popular camera mods, owner 2026-10-06). Zoom runs from min_distance metres to the map's maximum: max_fraction of its longer side, never below max_floor (Varos 14,080 m: about 7 km up). The tilt follows the zoom on one smooth curve through pitch_close (closest), pitch_mid (halfway on a log scale) and pitch_far (the maximum), degrees. Only scrolling out at the maximum opens the strategic map. wheel_step: zoom factor per wheel notch. pan and pan_fast (Shift): pan speed as a fraction of the camera distance per second (WASD and the screen edge). edge_px: the screen-edge band that pans. high_from: the zoom (0-1, log scale) from which the high-zoom look begins (fog thins, the territory wash rises, figures give way to banners). frame_margin: extra room when framing the realm. far_base and far_factor: the far clip plane is far_base + far_factor x distance. figure_hide: from this high-zoom amount (and beyond figure_hide_min metres) lord figures give way to their banners.

_height_note: Owner spec 2026-10-07 (A2): lords and banners at least 2x the 2026-10-04 size, and growing further as the camera rises, like TW:WH3: x1 below height_scale[0] metres of camera distance up to x height_scale[2] at height_scale[1] (log scale), clamped. Garrisoned lords stand just outside their settlement's walls (wall radius + garrison_gap).
